newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel off on futures and lacklustre demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel off on futures and lacklustre demand.

text.p: NWE jet fuel eased on Friday as slack demand, healthy production and softer benchmark IPE gas oil futures ate into price levels, traders said.
June IPE gas oil settled $1.50 lower at $164.25 a tonne fob ARA.
Traders quoted barge premiums at June gas oil $16.50/+$17.50 tonne fob ARA.
"There's not much going on, just bits and pieces," said one trader.
Fourth quarter swaps were quoted at +$26/+$27 over the IPE gas oil strip, while third quarter paper was seen at +$21 over the gas oil strip for that period.
On the cargo front, premiums for cif NWE cargoes were put at June IPE +$17.50. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
